protected_authorization.failure_rule: If any property is absent, stale, mismatched, rolled back, replayed, corrupted, or unverified, protected cross-turn continuation is unavailable and fails closed.

pending_authorization_state_rule: Durable storage of PendingAuthorizationState does not make the state active, trusted, resumable, or authorized. The existing Security Restraint and Authorization Evaluator contracts still decide those semantics from qualifying evidence.

local_mirror_reference_disposition.ordinary_continuity: useful structural evidence only; provider implementation and live availability remain unproven

sur011_not_decided: unrelated-turn behavior while authorization is pending
